articles.title: Snake Enters Girls’ Hostel in Maharashtra, Bites Sleeping Students; 3 Dead, Several Hospitalised
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Maharashtra)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Three young girls—Anu Koreti, Deepika Lakda, and Sushmita Mandal—died and several others fell seriously ill after a venomous snake bit them while they were sleeping on the floor of their hostel dormitory at a residential Ashram school in Maharashtra's Gadchiroli district. Authorities have launched a

body.html:
Three young girls died and several others fell seriously ill after a venomous snake allegedly entered a hostel dormitory at an aided residential Ashram school in Gadchiroli, Maharashtra, during the early hours of Monday.

The incident occurred around 2 am at the school in Japtalai village of Dhanora taluka, where nearly 79 girl students were reportedly sleeping on the floor of their hostel room when the snake entered and allegedly bit several students.

The affected students were immediately taken to a primary health facility in Dhanora for treatment. Two students died while undergoing initial treatment, while a third was shifted in an emergency to the District General Hospital in Gadchiroli, where she later succumbed.

The deceased have been identified as Anu Koreti (Class 2), Deepika Lakda (Class 6) and Sushmita Mandal (Class 8).

According to Dr Manish Meshram, a cardiologist at the District General Hospital in Gadchiroli, medical teams are continuously monitoring the surviving students.

Class 5 student Deepika Bitkusai Madavi remains in critical condition, while two other girls are reportedly in serious condition.

Another 14 students have been kept under medical observation as a precautionary measure.

The school is operated by the Kuparlingo Educational and Cultural Development Research Institute, an organisation associated with former MP Marotrao Kowase.

Police and health officials have launched a coordinated investigation into the incident. Authorities are examining the circumstances surrounding the snake entering the hostel and whether any lapses in safety arrangements contributed to the tragedy.

The incident has also raised concerns over pest control, hostel safety measures, floor-sleeping arrangements and access to emergency medical care in residential schools located in remote areas.

articles.title: Tragic explosion at Gurugram factory claims four lives.
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Gurugram)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: Four people—Kaushik, Arun, Prashant, and Ram Avadh—were killed in a massive explosion at a fireball manufacturing plant in Gurugram's Daulatabad Industrial Area. Around 24 fire tenders battled the blaze following early-morning blasts. Authorities have formed a specialized team to investigate the cau

body.html:
Four Dead in Gurugram Factory Explosion

Four individuals tragically lost their lives in a devastating explosion at a fireball manufacturing facility in Gurugram's Daulatabad Industrial Area, confirmed local authorities.

The incident occurred in the early hours of Saturday, resulting in a massive blast that illuminated the entire vicinity, as depicted in video footage from the scene. A thick cloud of smoke and debris filled the night sky in the aftermath.

Approximately 24 fire engines promptly responded to the emergency, working tirelessly to contain the resulting blaze. Ramesh Kumar, a senior fire officer, described the challenging efforts: "We deployed fire tenders from nearby stations amidst ongoing blasts. The factory produces fireballs akin to fire extinguishers."

Adjacent structures suffered substantial damage, and tragically, Kaushik, Arun, Prashant, and Ram Avadh lost their lives in the explosion. Reports indicate that 15 individuals were present inside the factory during the incident.

Authorities have initiated a thorough investigation, forming a specialized team to determine the cause of the explosion. Witnesses reported hearing multiple explosions throughout the night, with the forceful blasts hurling iron sheets and causing significant financial losses to neighboring businesses.

The community mourns the loss of lives and continues to support those affected by this tragic event.

articles.title: Passenger Clings to Moving TNSTC Bus Windshield for 500 Metres After Driver Dispute in Hosur
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Tamil Nadu)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.caption: Passenger M Ramesh Kumar
articles.excerpt: A TNSTC bus driver in Hosur was suspended after a viral video showed a passenger clinging to the bus's front windshield for about 500 metres. The dangerous incident followed a heated argument when the driver attempted to move the vehicle despite the passenger standing in front of it.

body.html:
A Tamil Nadu State Transport Corporation (TNSTC) bus driver was suspended after a passenger allegedly clung to the front windshield of a moving bus for around 500 metres following an argument between the two in Hosur.

The incident took place on Thursday when a TNSTC town bus travelling from Hosur to Pannapalli stopped after a passenger from Bagalur boarded the bus to travel to Thummanapalli.

According to reports, the passenger allegedly asked driver M Ramesh Kumar to let him get down before reaching his destination. The driver reportedly refused, following which the passenger eventually got down at his destination.

A heated argument then allegedly broke out between the passenger and the driver. During the confrontation, the passenger reportedly stood in front of the bus and clung to its windshield when the driver attempted to move the vehicle.

The passenger remained hanging onto the front of the moving bus for around 500 metres before the vehicle was stopped.

A fellow passenger recorded the incident on a mobile phone, and the video later went viral on social media.

Taking note of the viral video and a complaint against the driver, the TNSTC General Manager suspended Ramesh Kumar from service on Friday, a day after the incident.

articles.title: ‘Mobile Theft’ Suspect Tied Up, Head Shaved and Paraded With Slipper Garland in UP Village; Two Arre
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Uttar Pradesh)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.excerpt: A father-son duo in Uttar Pradesh's Pathakpur village was arrested after a video went viral showing them tying up, shaving the head of, partially shaving the moustache of, and parading a youth accused of mobile theft wearing a shoe garland. Police registered a case following a complaint by the victi

body.html:
A case of alleged inhuman treatment of a youth on suspicion of mobile phone theft has come to light in Uttar Pradesh, where a father-son duo allegedly tied him up, shaved his head, cut off half his moustache and paraded him around the village wearing a garland of shoes and slippers.

A video of the incident went viral on social media on Sunday, following which police registered a case and arrested the two accused.

According to police, the youth, identified as Sonu Rajput, has previously been jailed twice in theft cases and is also allegedly addicted to drugs.

The incident reportedly took place in Pathakpur village under the Asiwan area. Raju Singh, a resident of Pathakpur, lives in a hut in his garden outside Gamel village.

According to the complaint, on the night of July 30, Sonu allegedly stole the mobile phones of Raju and his son Raj. The following day, Raju's phone was found near a closed kiosk, while Sonu was reportedly missing.

Raju and Raj later learned that Sonu had gone to Lucknow and allegedly tracked him down before bringing him back to his home.

The two then allegedly subjected Sonu to the humiliating treatment. His hands were tied with a rope, his head was shaved, half his moustache was cut and a garland made of shoes and slippers was placed around his neck before he was allegedly paraded through the village.

The entire incident was reportedly recorded on video, which later surfaced on social media.

Asiwan SHO Pradeep Kumar Singh said that based on a complaint filed by Sonu's father, Gokul, a case has been registered against Raju and Raj. Both accused have been arrested and are expected to be sent to jail.

articles.title: CCTV Captures Eeco Car Rolling Into CNG Tanker Driver at Gujarat Petrol Pump, Driver Dies
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Gujarat)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.caption: The deceased has been identified as Rajendrasinh Parmar
articles.excerpt: A CNG tanker driver, Rajendrasinh Parmar, was fatally struck by a parked Eeco car that suddenly rolled forward at a petrol pump in Gujarat's Ambaji. The victim, who was resting on a cot after unloading gas, was rushed to the hospital but declared dead on arrival. Police have detained the driver.

body.html:
A tragic accident at the Shiva Ambika CNG petrol pump in Ambaji, Gujarat, was captured on CCTV, showing the moment an Eeco car allegedly rolled forward and fatally struck a CNG tanker driver who was resting outside the office.

The deceased has been identified as Rajendrasinh Parmar, who had reportedly completed unloading gas from the tanker and was sitting on a cot near the office when the incident occurred.

According to the CCTV footage, the Eeco car was parked at the filling station with its rear door open while CNG was being refilled. Moments later, the vehicle suddenly moved forward and rammed into the cot on which Rajendrasinh was resting.

The impact left staff and customers at the petrol pump shocked. Employees and bystanders immediately rushed to rescue the injured driver before shifting him to Ambaji Civil Hospital.

However, doctors declared him dead on arrival.

Following the incident, the victim's son, Divyarajsinh Parmar, lodged a complaint at the Ambaji Police Station.

Based on the complaint, police took the driver of the Eeco car into custody, registered a case, and launched an investigation.

Officials said the CCTV footage is being examined to determine the exact sequence of events and establish whether negligence led to the fatal accident.

articles.title: Lucknow SI Suspended After B.Ed Student Alleges Sexual Exploitation on False Promise of Marriage
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Uttar Pradesh)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.caption: According to the victim, the accused officer, identified as Dharmveer Shahi.
articles.excerpt: A senior sub-inspector in Lucknow's Ashiyana Police Station has been suspended and booked after a B.Ed student accused him of sexually exploiting her under the false promise of marriage while investigating her prior complaint. The case is currently under investigation by the ACP.

body.html:
A senior sub-inspector posted at Ashiyana Police Station in Lucknow has been suspended and booked after a B.Ed student accused him of sexually exploiting her on the false promise of marriage while investigating her earlier complaint.

The allegations are currently being investigated by the Assistant Commissioner of Police (ACP), Cantonment.

Deputy Commissioner of Police (Central) Vikrant Veer confirmed that an FIR has been registered against Senior Sub-Inspector Dharmveer Shahi, who has been placed under suspension.

According to the complainant, she had earlier filed a case against a man from Basti district, alleging that he had established a physical relationship with her on the false promise of marriage. The case was later transferred to Ashiyana Police Station in Lucknow through a Zero FIR, where Dharmveer Shahi was appointed as the investigating officer.

The student alleged that on February 21, Shahi called her to the police station and informed her that he would personally investigate the case. She claimed he later began contacting her frequently and allegedly made obscene remarks during their conversations.

According to the complaint, the officer allegedly told her that since the case was old, she would have to establish physical relations again to strengthen the investigation. When she objected, he allegedly promised to marry her, give her the status of a wife, and remain with her for life.

The woman alleged that, relying on these assurances, she was sexually exploited multiple times between March and July.

She further claimed that about one-and-a-half months ago, she accompanied the accused to Varanasi, where she discovered that he was already married. When she confronted him and demanded marriage, he allegedly began avoiding her and later assaulted and abused her.

The complainant also alleged that on the night of July 30, Shahi summoned her to Ashiyana Police Station, where he and two others allegedly assaulted her, snatched her mobile phone, and threatened to kill her and her family if she approached senior police officials.

She alleged that her phone was taken to destroy chats, photographs, videos, and other evidence.

Police have registered a case against the suspended officer. Officials said the allegations are under investigation, and further legal action will be taken based on the findings of the inquiry.

articles.title: Delhi Road Turns Into Dustbin? Viral Video Shows Commuter Dumping Waste in Broad Daylight
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Delhi)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.caption: Delhi
articles.excerpt: A viral Delhi video showing a commuter dumping food waste onto a public road has sparked social media outrage over civic sense. As calls for stricter penalties grow, the Delhi Traffic Police stated the Area Traffic Inspector has been notified for action.

body.html:
A viral video from Delhi has sparked outrage after allegedly showing a commuter dumping disposable food plates and other waste directly onto a public road before driving away.

The incident, captured in broad daylight, has triggered criticism on social media over civic sense and public cleanliness. Several users questioned why busy roads and public spaces continue to be treated as dumping grounds despite regular municipal cleaning efforts.

Many netizens have called for stricter enforcement and heavier penalties against people caught littering in public places. Some also suggested using vehicle registration numbers captured on camera to identify and penalise offenders.

The video has also renewed the wider debate over individual responsibility and civic behaviour in urban areas, where similar incidents of people throwing food wrappers and other waste from vehicles are frequently reported.

The Delhi Traffic Police said the Area Traffic Inspector has been informed for necessary action. It also advised citizens to report traffic violations through the Delhi Traffic Police Prahari App.

articles.title: Man Performs 'Pind Daan' of Living Wife, Posts Video on WhatsApp; FIR Sought in Firozabad
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Uttar Pradesh)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.caption: Husband Jitendra Prakash, Wife Deepa Swarnkar
articles.excerpt: A Firozabad man allegedly performed the ritualistic 'Pind Daan' for his living wife, Deepa Swarnkar, recording it by the Yamuna and sharing it on WhatsApp with the word "Late" on her photo. Deepa filed a police complaint accusing him and her in-laws of dowry harassment and threats. The husband is ab

body.html:
A shocking case has emerged from Uttar Pradesh's Firozabad, where a man allegedly performed the 'Pind Daan' (a Hindu ritual for the deceased) of his living wife, recorded the ritual on the banks of the Yamuna River, and shared the video on his WhatsApp status.

The woman, Deepa Swarnkar, was left shocked after seeing the video. On Sunday afternoon, she approached the Linepar Police Station and lodged a complaint against her husband and in-laws, accusing them of dowry harassment, physical assault, criminal intimidation, and mental harassment.

According to Deepa, she married Jitendra Prakash in 2014. She alleged that ever since the marriage, her husband, mother-in-law, sister-in-law, and brother-in-law had been harassing her over dowry demands.

She further alleged that on July 30, her in-laws assaulted her, forcing her to lock herself inside a room to protect her life. She also claimed to possess an audio recording in which her husband allegedly threatened to kill her.

Deepa stated that on August 2, despite her being alive, her husband performed her Pind Daan, bathed at the Yamuna ghat after the ritual, and uploaded the video to his WhatsApp status. He also allegedly used her photograph with the word "Late" written on it.

When she objected, her husband allegedly told her that she was "dead" to him and that he would no longer live with her.

The woman said the incident has left her and her two young children mentally traumatised. She has demanded that police register an FIR against all the accused and ensure the safety of her family.

Linepar Police Station Inspector Ramit Kumar Arya said the husband is allegedly an alcoholic and that the incident followed a domestic dispute.

Police said the accused is currently absconding, and efforts are underway to trace him. Further legal action will be taken based on the investigation.

articles.title: Umar Ahmed's Convoy Sparks Toll Plaza Chaos in Prayagraj: 28 Vehicles Booked After Barrier Ramming Allegations
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Uttar Pradesh)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.caption: Umar
articles.excerpt: Action has been taken against 28 vehicles whose drivers allegedly broke through a toll barrier, abused staff, and threatened them during a convoy escorting Mohammad Umar, Atiq Ahmed's elder son, to Prayagraj on parole. Police are using CCTV footage to identify the suspects and vehicles involved.

body.html:
Action has been initiated against 28 vehicles allegedly involved in a toll plaza incident while Mohammad Umar, the elder son of slain gangster Atiq Ahmed, was being brought to Prayagraj on parole.

The vehicles have been booked following a complaint by Jaiprakash Yadav, Assistant Manager of Nawabganj Toll Plaza. The incident allegedly took place around 3:50 pm on August 8 at toll booth number three.

According to the complaint, Umar was being brought from Lucknow to Prayagraj under police escort. After the police vehicles crossed the toll plaza, around 25–30 private vehicles allegedly followed the convoy.

The drivers of these vehicles allegedly broke through the boom barrier at high speed without paying the toll. When toll employees attempted to stop them, they were allegedly abused and threatened with death.

The complaint further alleges that some drivers drove towards the toll employees at high speed, apparently attempting to run them over. The employees reportedly moved aside to save themselves. The incident allegedly damaged the toll barrier and caused revenue loss to the toll operator.

Police are identifying the vehicles using CCTV footage and the registration numbers mentioned in the complaint. Officials said some vehicles allegedly had incomplete or missing registration numbers. The vehicles reportedly included Mahindra XUV, Creta, Thar, Scorpio, Swift, WagonR, Dzire, Fortuner and Brezza, among others.

Why Umar Was Brought to Prayagraj

The convoy was linked to Umar's parole following the death of his younger brother Aban Ahmed, who died in a road accident in Jhansi on August 6.

Aban was reportedly travelling to meet his brother Ali Ahmed, who is lodged in Jhansi jail, when the speeding car lost control and crashed into a divider. Aban and his companion Sonu, who were seated in the front, died at the spot, while three others were injured.

Following Aban's death, Umar and Ali sought permission from the Allahabad High Court to attend his funeral in Prayagraj. The court granted permission on August 7, subject to conditions and restrictions.

Umar was brought from Lucknow jail and Ali from Jhansi jail under police security on August 8.

As the convoy entered Prayagraj, vehicles of their supporters and associates reportedly joined it, with a large number of vehicles eventually seen near Kasari-Masari.

Police Probe Underway

Nawabganj Police Station SHO Pankaj Awasthi said investigators are examining CCTV footage from the toll plaza, statements of toll employees and vehicle numbers recorded in the complaint.

Police will also determine which vehicles crossed the toll plaza during the incident and which vehicle allegedly damaged the boom barrier.

A case has been registered, and further investigation is underway.

articles.title: Teacher Stabbed 27 Times Inside Classroom; Man Held Hours After Brutal Revenge Killing
articles.category: National News > State, City & Local News (Haryana)
articles.author: The Times Patriot
articles.caption: The accused Amit and the deceased Sandhya.
articles.excerpt: A 30-year-old man was arrested for allegedly stabbing a private school teacher 27 times to death inside a school in Haryana's Faridabad district. Police suspect the brutal attack was an act of revenge following a prior molestation complaint filed against the accused by the victim.

body.html:
A 30-year-old man was arrested on Monday evening for allegedly stabbing a private school teacher to death inside her school premises in Haryana's Faridabad district. Police believe the murder was an act of revenge linked to an earlier molestation complaint filed by the victim.

The deceased, identified as Sandhya, a resident of Dabua, Ballabhgarh, was attacked around 9:30 am at Saraswati Senior Secondary School in Sikrona village.

According to police, the accused, Amit, a resident of Kot village, allegedly inflicted around 27 stab wounds on Sandhya's neck, chest, stomach and face, killing her on the spot.

Investigators said Sandhya had lodged a molestation complaint against Amit several days before the incident. Although he had publicly apologised following the complaint, police suspect he held a grudge against her, which allegedly led to the fatal attack.

School operator Tejpal, an eyewitness, said the accused arrived wearing a face mask and calmly asked staff to call Sandhya.

"He came to the gate and said, 'Please call Sandhya ma'am.' As soon as she arrived, he attacked her," Tejpal said.

Hearing screams, Tejpal rushed outside and found Sandhya lying on the ground while the accused allegedly continued stabbing her. When he tried to intervene, the attacker reportedly threatened him with the knife, forcing him to back away.

A graphic video of the incident has surfaced and is being examined by investigators. The footage allegedly shows the teacher attempting to escape before collapsing, while the accused continued the assault. A bystander who tried to intervene was also reportedly threatened.

Police and forensic teams reached the scene shortly after receiving the alert. Sandhya was taken to a nearby hospital, where doctors declared her dead.

Police post in-charge Manoj Kumar said a murder case has been registered and preliminary investigation points to a revenge motive linked to the earlier complaint.

The accused was arrested later the same day and remains in police custody. Police are continuing their investigation to establish the complete sequence of events and determine whether anyone else was involved.
